title: Charge Limit
fullStatus: Battery full; Travel remains active while plugged in.
chargingStatus: Charging toward 100%; confirmed by the battery.
notCharging: 100% limit set, but the battery is not charging. Check the charger.
plugIn: AC power is not detected. Plug in a charger to select 100%.
unsupported: This battery does not expose charge thresholds.
grace: Unplugged: Travel is retained briefly. After five minutes, Everyday returns.
changeFailed: Could not change the charge profile. Check AC power and charge-helper permissions.
care:
Lithium-ion batteries wear through chemical changes. Heat and long periods at full charge speed that wear.

Everyday · %1% balances useful runtime with less time at high charge. Travel · 100% gives you maximum runtime when you need it, and keeps that limit while plugged in.

The five-minute grace lets you switch outlets or docks without losing Travel. Stay unplugged longer and Everyday returns automatically. This changes the charging limit—it does not drain your stored charge.
